body:
Here is some testing with accessibility in inner classes:
```gdscript
@tool
extends EditorScript

func _run() -> void:
	var inner_class_object: ParentContainer.Parent1 = ParentContainer.Parent1.new()
	inner_class_object.print_outer_const()	# valid
	inner_class_object.print_outer_enums()	# valid
	
	var child_class_object: ChildClass = ChildClass.new()   # `ChildClass` inherits from `ParentContainer.Parent1`
	child_class_object.print_outer_const()	# valid
	child_class_object.print_outer_enums()	# valid
	
	#ChildClass.Parent1		
	# parse (editor) error	(valid)
	# Although `Parent1` was suggested by autocomplete

	child_class_object.ContainerEnum1    # No parse error (valid)
	# runtime interruption (error)	(valid)
	# Although `ContainerEnum1` was suggested by autocomplete
```
It seems the outer constant members act like private variables.
If that is the intended behavior.
It concludes that there is a minor issue with the autocompletion in that case.
